## Functions

### `sd_append`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_append(void* data, uint16_t type_size, uint32_t len, const char* fname, uint32_t* points_w);
```

Append content to a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to content to be appended. |
| `type_size` | Size of data type in byte. |
| `len` | Length of data (not in byte). |
| `fname` | Name of the file. Has to exist. |
| `points_w` | Amount of bytes that were actually written to the file. |

**Returns:** Error code.

### `sd_append_txt`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_append_txt(void* data, uint32_t len, const char* fname, uint32_t* points_w);
```

Append text to a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to c-string to be appended. |
| `len` | Length of string. This must include the trailing "\0"! |
| `fname` | Name of the file. Has to exist. |
| `points_w` | Amount of chars that were actually written to the file. For text, this will usually be len-1, because the trailing "\0" is not written. |

**Returns:** Error code.

### `sd_cat`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_cat(const char *fname, char* pret, uint16_t len);
```

List text content of a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `fname` | Name of the file. Has to exist. |
| `pret` | Pointer to empty char array. |
| `len` | Length of char array including the trailing "\0". |

**Returns:** Error code.

> **Note:** If the buffer is not large enough for all of the content in the file, only the initial values in the buffer will be shown.

### `sd_file_exists`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

### `sd_init`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_init(int32_t max_files, uint32_t max_freq_khz);
```

Initialize the SD card config struct.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `max_files` | Max amount of files in FS. |
| `max_freq_khz` | Max bus transfer speed. Pass 0 to use the default value. |

**Returns:** Error code.

> **Note:** Regsiters the CLI callable "sdcard" job and registers/launches the hidden "sdstrm" data streaming job.

### `sd_read`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_read(void* data, uint16_t type_size, uint32_t len, const char* fname, const char* mode, uint32_t pos, uint32_t* points_r);
```

Read content from a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|

**Returns:** Error code.

### `sd_stream_in`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_stream_in(void* data, uint32_t len, uint8_t bps, uint8_t nch, FILE* f, uint32_t* points_w);
```

Write to SD with an open file pointer supplied from outside.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to empty data array. |
| `len` | Length of data (not in byte). |
| `bps` | Bits per single channel sample (resolution). |
| `nch` | Amount of active channels. |
| `f` | Already opened file pointer. |
| `points_w` | Amount of data points that were actually written to the file. |

**Returns:** Error code.

> **Note:** The file pointer **needs** to be opened in 'ab' mode, otherwise data will be destroyed. Additionally, should an error occur, the function **does not** close the file. Close it from outside!

### `sd_stream_open`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
FILE* sd_stream_open(const char* fname, const char* mode);
```

Open file stream indefinitely for out-of-scope operations.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `fname` | Name of the file. |
| `mode` | IO mode. Use either "ab" or "rb" for write or read streams |

**Returns:** FILE pointer to opened file.

> **Note:** Needs to be closed in separate call with `sd_stream_close()`.

### `sd_write`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_write(void* data, uint16_t type_size, uint32_t len, const char* fname, const char* mode, uint32_t pos, uint32_t* points_w);
```

Write content to a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to content to be written. |
| `type_size` | Size of data type in byte. |
| `len` | Length of data (not in byte). |
| `fname` | Name of the file. File is created if it does not exist. |
| `mode` | IO mode. Text and binary forms supported (w, wb) |
| `pos` | Position to start writing from. Uses `fseek`. This parameter is ignored when using mode "a"/"ab". |
| `points_w` | Amount of data points that were actually written to the file. |

**Returns:** Error code.

### `sd_write_txt`

_Source: `lib/sdcard/sdcard.h`_

```cpp
e_syserr_t sd_write_txt(char* data, uint32_t len, const char* fname, uint32_t pos, uint32_t* points_w);
```

Write text (char*) to a file.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to c-string. |
| `len` | Length of string. This must include the trailing "\0"! |
| `fname` | Name of the file. File is created if it does not exist. |
| `pos` | IO mode. Text forms supported (r, w, a). |
| `points_w` | Amount of chars that were actually written to the file. For text, this will usually be len-1, because the trailing "\0" is not written. |

**Returns:** Error code.
